title: Replay
none: Nothing is recorded yet: the replay records what the agent does while it has control.
off: This session records no replay: it was started with recording off.
unrecorded: Not recorded: a person had control, or the agent was not using the session
unsupported: This browser cannot play the replay: it needs AV1 video.
failed: The replay could not be played: {error}
stopped.unwritten: The replay stopped recording: it could not be written to the server's disk.
stalled: Part of the replay did not load.
